# kuncar.dev

> Jiří Kunčar (also written Jiri Kuncar), software engineer and author of SQLTy, a static type checker for raw SQL in Python.

## Developer

- [CV](https://jiri.kuncar.dev/): experience, articles, publications, education and contact details
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jirikuncar): source code, as `jirikuncar`
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3995-3795): researcher identifier 0000-0002-3995-3795
- [Twitter](https://twitter.com/jirikuncar): `@jirikuncar`

## SQLTy

Type-safe raw SQL for Python 3.14+: row and parameter types inferred from SQL strings and your schema, checked by mypy, Pyright or ty, no database needed. MIT licensed. The package name is `sqlty`.

- [Documentation](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/): home page
- [llms.txt](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/llms.txt): documentation index for language models; start here for questions about SQLTy
- [llms-full.txt](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/llms-full.txt): the full documentation as one text file
- [Installation](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/installation/): how to install SQLTy
- [Quickstart](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/quickstart/): first typed query
- [Playground](https://sqlty.kuncar.dev/playground/): try SQLTy in the browser
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/sqlty/): Python package
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/jirikuncar/sqlty): GitHub repository
